name: Ribcage Crawler
summary: A cage of ribs scuttling on finger-bones, snapping shut around whatever it can reach.
description: Tomb robbers call them traps, and cultists call them pets. They hide under silt and rubble and wait for a sleeper to stretch out a hand.

traits.name: False Appearance
traits.text: While motionless, the crawler is indistinguishable from a heap of loose bones.

actions.name: Snap Shut
actions.onHit: If the target is a Medium or smaller creature, it has the {ref:condition/grappled} condition (escape {dc:str}). Until the grapple ends, the target has the {ref:condition/restrained} condition, and the crawler can't use Snap Shut on another target.
